description: Action with a floating-point member. This vector demonstrates divergence in the opposite direction from diff-01/02/03: plain RFC 8785 JCS accepts the float and produces a deterministic digest; jcs-n MUST-FAIL because §3.1 forbids floating-point values in digest-bearing fields. A composition implementation following §6.3.2 literally (plain JCS) produces a usable digest; a CPB verifier applying jcs-n fails closed. The two constructions do not merely produce different digests — one refuses to produce any digest at all.

jcs.algorithm: RFC 8785 (plain JCS, no normalization pass, floats allowed)

jcs_n.note: jcs-n §3.1: monetary and quantity values MUST be exact decimal strings, not JSON floating-point numbers. The value 0.95 is a JSON float. A conforming jcs-n implementation MUST NOT compute a digest for this input.
